name: utf8-guard
description: Keeps Korean, Japanese and Chinese in tool calls as UTF-8 instead of \uXXXX escapes that turn into wrong characters, holds back calls whose text looks broken, and says when the upstream bug is fixed

upstream_check.title: Notify when fixed upstream
upstream_check.description: Once a day, ask GitHub whether anthropics/claude-code#83033 is closed as fixed, and say so at session start so you can turn this plugin off

hangul_check.title: Check Korean syllables
hangul_check.description: Hold a tool call back once when it contains Hangul syllables outside the 2,350 of KS X 1001, the usual result of a broken escape
